integrity: The proof is analytic and derives the Fourier multiplier, Diophantine lower bound, Parseval estimate, and sharpness sequence explicitly. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to badly approximable alpha/pi only. It controls the support-function shape modulo constant and first Fourier modes in H^-1 from an L2 chord-function defect; it does not establish Hausdorff, L-infinity, or L2 support stability, or cover all irrational angles.
title: Diophantine Stability of Isoptic-Chord Rigidity
